newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Media in financing talks.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Media in financing talks.

text.p: Advanced Media Inc said Thursday that it is in advanced stages of discussions to obtain financing that will help with its expanded focus on sales and marketing, software development, and implementation of Internet strategies.

Advanced Media said that twoards the end of the first quarter it signed a contract to provide 384 informational kiosks for General Nutrition Co, which it expects to have a positive effect on revenues.
The company also said that its sales efforts and strategies within the multimedia and electronic commerce divisions which are expected to provide additional revenues.

Advanced Media is a developer of Interactive multimedia products for business, including touch-screen interactive point-of-sale and information systems, multimedia products, architectural design products, database management technologies, Web sites, and Inter-, Intra- and Extranet projects.
